agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on Wednesday, August 26, 2026 in Agriculture and Rural Affairs Committee Report 38.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on Wednesday, August 19, 2026, and the deadline to register by email to speak is 9:00 am on Thursday, August 20, 2026.
agenda_items.minutes: These “Summary Minutes” indicate the disposition of items and actions taken at the meeting. This document does not include all of the text that will be included in the full Minutes, such as the record of written and oral submissions. Recorded votes and dissents contained in the Summary Minutes are draft until the full Minutes of the meeting are confirmed by the Committee. The draft of the full Minutes (for confirmation) will be published with the agenda for the next regular Committee meeting and, once confirmed, will replace this document.

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Laurel McCreight, Rural Strategic Support Coordinator, Business and Technical Support Services, Planning, Development and Building Services Department spoke to a detailed slide presentation which served as an overview of the report and was in attendance to respond to questions. A copy of this presentation is held on file with the Office of the City Clerk.
Following the presentation, Motion No. ARAC 2026-38-01 was introduced.
The following member of the public spoke before the Committee and provided comments on the item:
The following members of staff were also in attendance to respond to questions:
Marcia Wallace, General Manager Planning, Development and Building Services Department
Debbie Stewart, General Manager Strategic Initiatives Department
Alain Gonthier, General Manager Public Works Department
Pierre Poirier, Chief Ottawa Paramedic Service
Krista O’Brien, Manager Billing and Assessment Finance and Corporate Services Department
Dan Chenier, General Manager Recreation, Cultural and Facility Services Department
Pat Scrimegour, Director Transit Customer Systems and PlanningTransit Services Department
Cinthia Pagé, Program Manager Social Development and Funding Community and Social Services Department
Erin Bertrand, Manager Employment and Social Services Community and Social Services Department
Julie Wiley, Coordinator, Partnership Employment and Social Services Community and Social Services Department
Caitlin Salter-MacDonald, City Clerk
Wendy Stephanson, City Manager.
At the conclusion of Committee discussions, Motion No. ARAC 2026-38-01 was put before the Committee and was ‘Carried’, as presented. The report recommendation was then ‘Carried’, as presented.

motions.motion_text:
Report Recommendation(s)
That the Agriculture and Rural Affairs Committee recommend Council receive this report for information including actions completed and underway to address principal themes and concerns identified during the 2024 Rural Summit and to deliver the next Rural Summit, as described in this report.

WHEREAS the Agriculture and Rural Affairs Committee directed staff to report on actions completed, actions underway, actions remaining outstanding, recommendations for future Committee consideration and implementation timelines arising from the 2024 Rural Summit; and
WHEREAS the report proposes annual reporting to the Agriculture and Rural Affairs Committee, with an interim report in Q1 2027; and
WHEREAS biannual reporting would provide Committee with more timely oversight of implementation, emerging challenges, funding requirements and actions requiring Council direction; and
WHEREAS a consolidated action tracker is necessary for Committee and the public to assess implementation progress, outstanding priorities, funding requirements and measurable results;
THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED that staff be directed to provide the first interim Rural Summit implementation update to the Agriculture and Rural Affairs Committee in Q1 2027, as already proposed, to follow with an update in Q2 and an update in Q4 2027, with biannual updates thereafter; and
BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that staff be directed to include, as part of the Q1 2027 Rural Summit progress report, a comprehensive action tracker identifying, at a minimum:
BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that each biannual update include:
BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that in addition to the biannual report rising to Committee, that the Rural Affairs Office organize briefings for individual Councillors regarding works in their specific Wards every two months to share any updates that arise from city staff meetings with the individual responsible departments for the tasks identified in the report.
